The project 3D’omics (http://www.3domics.eu) was Funded by European Union’s Horizon 2020 Research and Innovation programme. 1.1 Prepare the R environment 1.1.1 Environment To reproduce all the analyses locally, clone this repository in your computer using: RStudio > New Project > Version Control > Git And indicating the following git repository: https://github.com/3d-omics/MSSM.git Once the R project has been created, follow the instructions and code chunks shown in this webbook. 1.1.2 Libraries The following R packages are required for the data analysis. Most modules can be installed directly from CRAN or GitHub. However, four modules are provided through Bioconductor and should be installed if needed with the command below before loading: # install.packages('BiocManager', dependencies = TRUE) # BiocManager::install(c("phyloseq", "ggtreeExtra","ggtree", "ALDEx2"))' if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman") # If the package is not installed, installs from CRAN pacman::p_load( tidyverse, rairtable, jsonlite, ape, ggpubr, broom, reshape2, zCompositions, ANCOMBC, ALDEx2, car, DHARMa, sjPlot, ggeffects, ggh4x, vegan, ggfortify, ggrepel, microbiome, ggforce, patchwork, grid, pheatmap, janitor, spdep, adespatial, adegraphics, ade4, magick, permuco, airtabler2, rmarkdown, purrr, PerformanceAnalytics ) # If the package is not installed, installs from GitHub pacman::p_load_gh( "anttonalberdi/hilldiv2", "anttonalberdi/distillR", "wilkelab/cowplot", "david-barnett/microViz" ) select <- dplyr::select recode <- dplyr::recode 1.2 Define Plotting Settings 1.2.1 Color Schemes 1.2.2 Plotting Theme 1.3 Load Functions The functions defined below are used throughout other sections of this analysis and must be loaded before running those parts. source("resources/scripts/MSSM_functions_pre.R") source("resources/scripts/JEC_1743_sm_apps5.R") University of Copenhagen, carlotta.pietroni@sund.ku.dk↩︎ University of the Basque Country, jorgeeliseo.langa@ehu.eus↩︎ University of Copenhagen, inaki.larranaga@sund.ku.dk↩︎ University of Copenhagen, amalia.bogri@sund.ku.dk↩︎ University of Copenhagen, antton.alberdi@sund.ku.dk↩︎
